Inequality comes in many shapes and shades, and sometimes it may also be invisible. This #WomensDay, Greenlam urges everybody to be more mindful of gender barriers, that may not always be apparent at first.

#GreenlamIndustries #HappyWomensDay #WomensDay2022 #GenderEquality
